description: Use when an agent needs the words in an audio file. Returns the text, timed segments and the spoken language for mp3, wav, m4a, ogg or webm audio (10 MB, 5 minutes, checked from the file). Cached 24 hours by the audio itself. Costs 0.02 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

url.description: the audio file: an absolute http or https URL

name: get_transcribe

data.description: the get_transcribe payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_transcribe

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Speech to text
